show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/B5k8E6
show.description: A poor vegetable seller, Vikram, secretly a former business tycoon, lives a quiet life while his son Ishaan struggles in the city and pretends to be an orphan to marry into a wealthy family. When Vikram attends the wedding, he is humiliated by the bride’s family, and Ishaan, under pressure, denies him. As tensions peak, Vikram reveals his true identity as a powerful CEO, exposing their arrogance and proving that dignity, truth, and family matter more than wealth.
